create_soccer_task: create a soccer Task with players, arena, ball, initializer, and observables for multi-agent MuJoCo soccer
create_multiturn_task: create a MultiturnTask for continuous soccer gameplay that resets after goals without terminating the episode
get_reward: get per-player rewards where scoring team gets +1 and conceding team gets -1
disable_geom_contacts: disable physical contacts between player walkers by setting contype to zero on all geoms
